name: cc-anchor
description: cc-anchor: a Claude Code plugin whose anchor card (goal, invariants, breadcrumbs, cursor) survives context compaction. This repository is its own marketplace.

plugins.name: cc-anchor
plugins.description: Anchor card that survives context compaction: written to disk on PreCompact, re-injected verbatim on SessionStart(compact), plus a drift statusline. Works without kronicle-lite; with it, re-presents your cursor.
